image_description: A close-up, low-light photograph of a hand holding a lit disposable lighter. The flame is bright with a blue base and yellow tip, illuminating the thumb and part of the index finger. The body of the lighter appears to be metallic or gold-colored plastic, partially obscured by shadow and the hand. The background is completely black.
